about: Removals of proved violations on existing fixtures (ADR 0995; scripts/guard/regress.mjs). A violation the base held that a snapshot no longer holds (turned uncertifiable, or gone) needs a row: fixture, path, code, how many left that path, the ADR and why. Append-only; unnamed removals fail.

regress.why: a closure a memo compute returns, never called (typeof run() only reads the value): line 23 of ReturnedAsyncClosure is a site no run reaches; Chrome rc.21 reports nothing there (static-only on c2779cb39), and the fixture README itself lists it as a negative. ADR 1020 makes the reach query undecided there

the violation was false: ChildNodes iterates the childNodes of an element document.createElement("i") makes there, which has no child, so the callback never runs (Chrome silent); it is uncertifiable function-unentered, never a violation

an earlier check Solid makes at the same call is proven to throw first (SC6002 at an effect created on an apply's stack; SC3001's refusal on a tracked caller's run of the same onCleanup), so the owner check is not proven reached: Chrome reports only the earlier code (runtime-oracle/competing-check-*)

SC2008 at a flush that provably never runs (after a return, under if (false), in the apply of an effect whose compute throws first, in an effect never registered, in a createRoot init refused in an apply) is uncertifiable under ADR 1018; Chrome reports nothing there (runtime-oracle/flush-in-effect-callback, patterns/deadflush)
